capabilities: : Paste images using standard Markdown syntax
disambiguation: Not an image classification tool; it manages image insertion and link conversion within Markdown files.
intentEvidence: Different from the default action, This plug-in allows you to insert pictures using standard Markdown link syntax
problem: Standard image pasting in Obsidian may not use standard Markdown syntax or place files in predictable locations, affecting document compatibility.
summary: Image Classify Paste allows users to insert images using standard Markdown syntax and batch converts existing image links to a compatible format, similar to Typora.
